title: End-to-End Neural Modeling of EM Response and Design Performance for Free-Form RFIC Passives
abstract: arXiv:2610.34462v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Passive matching networks are critical components in radio-frequency integrated circuits (RFICs), but their design is bottlenecked by expensive finite-difference-based electromagnetic (EM) simulation. We propose an end-to-end neural framework for free-form RFIC passives that predicts both EM response and downstream design performance under varying frequency and circuit contexts, combining a frequency-conditioned neural simulator with a circuit-conditioned neural solver. To improve design performance prediction, the simulator outputs a neural EM response consisting of both the explicit EM response and a complementary response, together with a dependence regularizer that encourages the two responses to capture orthogonal information. To evaluate the proposed framework, we construct a large-scale dataset of free-form passive layouts, synthesized from both expert-designed contours and random paths. Our 21M-parameter model achieves high acc

translated_title: 自由形式射频集成电路（RFIC）无源器件的电磁响应与设计性能端到端神经建模
translated_abstract: 无源匹配网络是射频集成电路（RFIC）中的关键组件，但其设计受到昂贵的基于有限差分的电磁（EM）仿真这一瓶颈的制约。我们提出了一种面向自由形式RFIC无源器件的端到端神经框架，能够在不同频率和电路环境下同时预测电磁响应和下游设计性能，该框架结合了频率条件化的神经模拟器与电路条件化的神经求解器。为了改进设计性能的预测，模拟器输出由显式电磁响应和互补响应组成的神经电磁响应，并通过一个依赖性正则化器促使这两种响应捕获正交的信息。为了评估所提出的框架，我们构建了一个大规模的自由形式无源版图数据集，该数据集由专家设计的轮廓和随机路径综合生成。我们2100万参数的模型实现了高精（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种结合频率条件化神经模拟器与电路条件化神经求解器的端到端神经框架，能够对自由形式RFIC无源器件在不同频率与电路环境下同时预测电磁响应与设计性能，从而突破昂贵电磁仿真带来的设计瓶颈。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes an end-to-end neural framework combining a frequency-conditioned neural simulator with a circuit-conditioned neural solver to predict both EM response and downstream design performance for free-form RFIC passives under varying frequency and circuit contexts, overcoming the bottleneck of expensive electromagnetic simulation.
